"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans hail the strong and broad-based cooperation of America's allies in the War on Terror.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"More than 30 nations have forces serving in Iraq.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Allies have taken up responsibilities in a spirit of solidarity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 9/11 Commission judges international cooperation in the War on Terror to be on a vastly enlarged scale.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"International cooperation in the War on Terror has expanded dramatically since September 11, 2001.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A candidate nominated by opponents has insulted allies by calling nations fighting in Iraq \"window-dressing\".",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A candidate nominated by opponents has referred to nations fighting in Iraq as a \"coalition of the coerced and the bribed\".",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Directing ugly rhetoric at America's allies in a time of war is irresponsible.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The vast majority of Americans have gratitude and respect for the men and women from other nations who are risking their lives to make the world safer.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
